feeds.title: Hinman & Carmichael
feeds.description: Hinman & Carmichael specialize in the laws related to the production, distribution and sale of alcoholic beverages. They can address your needs in licensing and qualification, business and marketing practices, and represent you before federal and state agencies that regulate alcoholic beverages. Follow the site's blog and read about alcohol, trade practices, events, company, social media and more.

feeds.title: Alcohol Law Review
feeds.description: AlcoholLawReview.com is a discussion board that allows users to quickly and easily gather information about many of the most pertinent developments in alcohol regulation and litigation. This site is intended to facilitate dialogue about current alcohol law cases, legal challenges, and issues around the country. The topics covered in their blog are amendments, alcohol news, equal protection, court-related news and more.

feeds.title: Center for Alcohol Policy
feeds.description: The purpose of the Center blog is to educate policymakers, regulators and the public about alcohol, its uniqueness and its regulation. By conducting sound research and implementing initiatives that will maintain the appropriate state-based regulation of alcohol, the Center promotes safe and responsible consumption of alcohol,

feeds.title: Libation Law Blog
feeds.description: Libation Law Blog is about legal news from alcoholic beverage and cannabis attorneys and regulatory insights from lawyers covering marijuana, craft beer, and wine.

feeds.title: Bristow Blog
feeds.description: Brook Bristow is a South Carolina-based lawyer at Bristow Beverage Law, who primarily counsels companies in the alcohol industry on business and employment laws, as well as on compliance, licensing, & intellectual property. The Bristow blog is about South Carolina brewery, the definitive guide to spring break alcohol laws, beer & kombucha are probably now illegal and more similar topics.

feeds.title: Alcoholic Beverages Law Blog
feeds.description: The Stoel Rives Alcohol Beverage Blog provides wineries, breweries, distilleries, cideries, distributors, and importers with articles and information across a broad spectrum of state and federal alcohol beverage laws. The blog shares their passion and experience with critical legal, business, and regulatory issues. The blog will share the latest developments in these areas and help you apply them to manage your business successfully.

feeds.title: Alcohol Law Advisor Blog
feeds.description: McDermott Will & Emery's Alcohol Law Advisor blog provides insight into the complex issues concerning alcohol regulation and distribution. Their alcohol regulatory and distribution lawyers represent clients across the full spectrum of US and international matters, including issues such as licensing, permitting, production, product formulation, taxation, trade practices, transportation, distribution, labeling, advertising, and marketing of alcoholic beverages.

feeds.title: Alcohol Justice Blog
feeds.description: Alcohol Justice, the industry watchdog, promotes evidence-based public health policies and organizes campaigns with diverse communities and youth against alcohol and other drug industries' harmful practices. Their blog is about the latest news around the industry, events, press releases, and informative articles.
